\newcount\AJformatcount
\newwrite\AJentries\immediate\openout\AJentries=\jobname.entries
\newwrite\AJpieces\immediate\openout\AJpieces=\jobname.pieces
\newwrite\AJtails\immediate\openout\AJtails=\jobname.tails
\let\AJformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\AJformatcount by1\relax
  \edef\@currentlabel{T\the\dte@tnum R#1}\label{AUD:\the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \protected@write\AJentries{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}\AJformat{#1}}
\let\AJdraw\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{\protected@write\AJpieces{}{PIECE \the\dte@tnum:\the\numexpr\dte@piecenum+1\relax:#1}\AJdraw{#1}}
\let\AJretry\dte@retry@smaller
\def\dte@retry@smaller{\typeout{AJ RETRY tree=\the\dte@tnum;avail=\the\dte@availht;min=\dte@minht;actual=\the\dte@fitht;capacity=\the\dte@fitroom}\AJretry}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{AJ FORMATTED \the\AJformatcount}}
\makeatother
